UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Root user account record for Master Gate ownership verification.

ownerUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was last updated.

VaultDocument.title: VaultDocument
VaultDocument.description: Per-domain cloud sync document storing Athlete Profile, Zones, Availability, Injuries, Integrations (Strava, Garmin, Google Sheets), Goal Races, or Garmin Health Logs.

ownerUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the vault document owner.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version integer for forward compatibility.

payload.description: Native Firestore Map containing the domain settings, thresholds, zones, integrations, goals, or recovery logs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this vault document was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this vault document was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user document anchoring relational ownership for the user's cloud settings vault.

/users/{userId}/vault/{docId}.description: Subcollection storing isolated domain documents (profile, integrations, goals, recovery, coach) for the authenticated athlete.
